recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up portrait of a woman with dark hair and bangs, partially obscured by out-of-focus colorful flowers in the foreground, paired with right-aligned decorative swash typography and a technical header bar.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground floral blur creates depth against the sharp facial features
Right-aligned text balances the left-weighted portrait
Warm floral tones (red, yellow, orange) contrast with the cool, neutral background
Technical top banner provides a structural frame for the organic imagery
coreInvariants: White border framing the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a tight headshot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's eyes, positioned at the upper-left power point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down through the blurred flowers, then sweeps up to the right-aligned text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with imagery and text, using the white border as the primary relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones in the portrait and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant primary and secondary colors (red, yellow, orange) in the foreground flowers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple and bright red for the primary typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground and text against a desaturated, mid-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight serif with extreme swashes and ball terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature large, circular swash entries
Lowercase 'y' and 'g' have deep, looping tails

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the light background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Two colors of the same decorative typeface family separated by a horizontal rule.
graphicDevices: Technical header bar with vertical stripes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1960s/70s editorial soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary weight and decorative flair.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A square 1960s style photograph of a woman with dark hair and bangs looking slightly away. In the extreme foreground, large red and yellow flowers are heavily blurred, creating a soft bokeh effect that partially covers her chest and shoulders. The lighting is soft and naturalistic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white border around the image. At the top, place a thin technical bar with small vertical lines and metadata text. In the upper right, typeset the artist name in red and the title in deep purple using a heavy swash serif font, right-aligned and staggered.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground floral blur sufficiently soft?
Is the text right-aligned and using a swash-heavy font?
Is there a clear white border around the square image?
Does the color palette include the specific purple and red text tones?

mustRedesign: Exact catalog numbers in the header
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the woman's face.
Check that the swashes do not collide with adjacent lines of text.
Verify the technical header bar looks like a vintage catalog strip.
Confirm the square format is maintained within the white frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Foreground Bokeh + Right-Aligned Swash Typography + Technical Header Bar = 1960s Soul Aesthetic
